name: Daily plans tidy
description: Intended run: every day at 03:15 local time, from the project root, run `bash scripts/plans-tidy-daily.sh` with PLANS_TIDY_DAYS=7 and the default remote (origin) and branch (current branch, i.e. the PLANS_TIDY_REMOTE and PLANS_TIDY_BRANCH defaults). On finish, post the stdout counts; on a non-zero exit, raise an alert (the script writes .datawatch/reports/plans-tidy-alert.md on failure). NOT EXPRESSED IN THIS FILE: the Automation docs (docs/howto/automation-chains.md, docs/howto/autonomous.md) name only name, entry member, members (id, prd_id, kind, edges, fork/join and nested-automation fields) and budget fields. They document no schedule, command, working directory, environment or notification fields for an Automation, so the schedule (03:15 daily), the shell command, the working directory, PLANS_TIDY_DAYS=7 and the finish/alert behaviour are left out and must be set by the operator through the schedule and alert features. Members are also left out: an Automation chains Automatons (PRDs), and no Automaton exists for this script yet. Import will create a draft with the name only.
